score_range_label.zh: 中等确信度 (61.9) — 牛市运行中，广度修复

position_advice.en: 60-65% (Shift from 'buy NVDA' to 'buy undervalued AI supply chain' like DELL, QCOM. 35% cash waiting for June FOMC. Breadth above 60% = add to 70%)
position_advice.zh: 60-65%（从'买NVDA'转向'买AI供应链中被低估的环节'如DELL、QCOM。35%现金等6月FOMC。广度突破60%加仓至70%）

summary.en: Liquidity is expanding but a turning point is approaching. Net liquidity +$55B WoW, up +$232B from the April bottom. TGA continues to release funds (-$57.3B WoW). However, Warsh's QT has begun (-$14.9B WoW) and ON RRP is essentially zero, leaving no extra buffers. The liquidity peak is expected within 6-8 weeks.
summary.zh: 流动性正在扩张但转折临近。净流动性周环比 +$55B，从 4/22 底部回升 +$232B。TGA 持续释放（周环比 -$57.3B）。然而，Warsh 缩表已经启动（周环比 -$14.9B），且 ON RRP 基本归零，已无额外缓冲。预计流动性将在 6-8 周内见顶。

fed_balance_sheet_change.zh: -149 亿美元（周环比）——Warsh 缩表持续

rrp_note.en: Essentially zero — no extra liquidity buffer
rrp_note.zh: 基本归零——无额外流动性缓冲

net_liquidity_change.zh: 周环比 +$55B——从 4/22 底部回升 +$232B

details.en: The market is currently fueled by a $232B net liquidity injection since April. While TGA release is providing a temporary tailwind, the structural headwind of Warsh's QT is now active. With ON RRP exhausted, the system has fewer buffers against tightening. June FOMC will be critical in determining if QT accelerates to $50-100B/month, which would reverse the current expansion within 6-8 weeks.
details.zh: 自 4 月以来，$232B 的净流动性注入为市场提供了动力。虽然 TGA 释放提供了暂时顺风，但 Warsh 缩表的结构性逆风现已激活。随着 ON RRP 耗尽，系统对抗紧缩的缓冲减少。6 月 FOMC 将是关键，决定缩表是否会加速到每月 $50-100B，这将在 6-8 周内逆转当前的扩张。

reason.en: Net liquidity +$55B/wk, up $232B from bottom. 30Y yield eased to 5.06%. But Warsh QT has started (-$14.9B/wk) and ON RRP is exhausted.
reason.zh: 净流动性 +$55B/周，从底部回升 $232B。30Y 收益率降至 5.06% 缓解压力。但 Warsh 缩表已启动（-$14.9B/周），且 ON RRP 已耗尽。

status.zh: 分化加剧——AI 轮动活跃

reason.en: NVDA dropped 3.58% in two days post-earnings, but DELL (+16.77%) and QCOM (+11.60%) surged. PMI New Orders (44.8) signal deep manufacturing contraction. WMT confirms consumer pressure.
reason.zh: NVDA 财报后两天跌 3.58%，但 DELL (+16.77%) 和 QCOM (+11.60%) 飙升。PMI 新订单 (44.8) 预示制造业深度收缩。WMT 确认消费者承压。

reason.en: Stocks above 200DMA rose from 48.6% to 56.37% (+7.7ppt). Russell 2000 leading (+0.91%). Equal-weight S&P breaking out. Direction is positive but still below 60% threshold.
reason.zh: 200 日均线上方股票比例从 48.6% 升至 56.37%（+7.7%）。Russell 2000 领涨（+0.91%）。等权 S&P 正在突破。方向向上但仍低于 60% 门槛。

reason.en: S&P 7,473 and Dow 50,580 both at ATH. S&P on an 8-week winning streak. VIX low at 16.70. Global resonance with Nikkei (+2.68%) and DAX (+1.15%).
reason.zh: S&P 7,473 和 Dow 50,580 同创 ATH。S&P 连涨 8 周。VIX 处于 16.70 低位。全球共振：日经 (+2.68%) 和 DAX (+1.15%)。

trading_summary.en: 61.9 — Moderate. Bull market still running, liquidity is the engine, breadth is repairing. S&P 8-week winning streak is not random — $232B net liquidity injection is the fuel. Breadth recovered from 48.6% to 56.37%, equal-weight breaking out, Russell leading — market transitioning from 'few stocks dragging index' to 'broader participation'. NVDA's beat-and-sell is a 'change horses' signal not an 'exit' signal. Strategy: shift from 'buy NVDA' to 'buy undervalued AI supply chain' (DELL, QCOM). 60-65% position riding the trend, 35% cash waiting for June FOMC. Breadth above 60% = add to 70%. Warsh announces $50B+/month QT = cut to 50%.
trading_summary.zh: 61.9分，Moderate。牛市仍在运行，流动性是引擎，广度在修复。S&P连涨8周不是偶然——$232B净流动性注入就是燃料。广度从48.6%修复到56.37%，等权指数突破，Russell领涨——市场正在从'少数股票拖着走'转向'更广泛参与'。NVDA的beat-and-sell是'换马'信号不是'下车'信号。策略：从'买NVDA'转向'买AI供应链中被低估的环节'（DELL、QCOM）。60-65%仓位骑趋势，35%现金等6月FOMC。广度突破60%加仓至70%，Warsh宣布月缩$50B+减仓至50%。

trading_quote: Liquidity is the fuel, breadth is the repair. NVDA rotation is a 'change horses' signal.

note.zh: 风险偏好回升，金价回落

note.en: YTD -32% — sharp divergence from equity ATH
note.zh: YTD -32%——与股市 ATH 形成尖锐背离

exchange_flow_detail.en: YTD -32%, at yearly lows. Sharp divergence from S&P ATH persists. Market ignored Warsh's 'pro-crypto' reputation on Bitcoin Pizza Day.
exchange_flow_detail.zh: YTD -32%，处于年内低点。与 S&P ATH 的尖锐背离持续。市场在 Bitcoin Pizza Day 忽视了 Warsh 的'亲加密'名声。

analysis.en: BTC at $75,484 (-2.35%), YTD -32%. Historically, BTC leads equities by 6-8 weeks. This persistent divergence suggests either a major BTC bounce or an impending equity correction. The failure to rally on Warsh's swearing-in is a bearish sentiment signal.
analysis.zh: BTC 报 $75,484（-2.35%），YTD -32%。历史上，BTC 领先股市 6-8 周。这种持续的背离暗示要么 BTC 即将大涨，要么股市即将修正。在 Warsh 宣誓就职日未能反弹是一个看跌的情绪信号。

analysis.en: Gold at $4,511/oz, pulling back from highs as risk appetite returns to equities. However, the structural bull case remains intact given fiscal concerns and geopolitical risks. Copper (+1.37%) rising confirms industrial demand.
analysis.zh: 黄金报 $4,511/盎司，随着风险偏好回流股市，金价从高位回落。然而，考虑到财政担忧和地缘政治风险，结构性牛市逻辑依然完整。铜价上涨 (+1.37%) 确认了工业需求。

detail.en: BTC is at YTD lows (-32%) while S&P is at ATH. Historically, BTC leads equities by 6-8 weeks. Either BTC is about to bounce or equities are about to correct. Warsh being sworn in as 'pro-crypto' Fed Chair didn't trigger a rally, which is a warning sign.
detail.zh: BTC 在年内低点（-32% YTD）而 S&P 在 ATH。历史上 BTC 领先股市 6-8 周。要么 BTC 即将反弹，要么股市即将修正。Warsh 作为'亲加密'Fed 主席宣誓就职并未触发反弹，这是一个警告信号。

detail.en: NVDA dropped 3.58% in two days despite the greatest quarter in history. However, DELL surged 16.77%. This suggests money is not leaving AI but rotating from overpriced leaders to undervalued supply chain partners. This is a 'change horses' signal.
detail.zh: 尽管交出了历史上最强季报，NVDA 两天内仍下跌 3.58%。然而，DELL 飙升 16.77%。这表明资金并未离开 AI，而是从定价过高的龙头轮动到被低估的供应链伙伴。这是一个'换马'信号。

detail.en: First week QT at -$14.9B is just the beginning. June FOMC (6/17-18) will reveal the full path. If monthly QT reaches $50-100B, the current +$55B/week net liquidity expansion will reverse to contraction within 6-8 weeks. This is the primary medium-term risk.
detail.zh: 第一周缩表 -$14.9B 只是开始。6 月 FOMC（6/17-18）将揭示完整路径。如果月度缩表达到 $50-100B，当前每周 +$55B 的净流动性扩张将在 6-8 周内逆转为收缩。这是主要的中期风险。

title.en: Active. BTC -32% YTD vs Equity ATH. NVDA Paradox. PMI 44.8 vs Equity ATH.
title.zh: 活跃。BTC -32% YTD vs 股市 ATH。NVDA 悖论。PMI 44.8 vs 股市 ATH。

detail.en: Divergences remain active. BTC at YTD lows while equities are at ATH is a classic leading indicator warning. NVDA's post-earnings drop despite record results suggests full pricing. PMI at 44.8 shows manufacturing in deep contraction, highlighting the disconnect between the real economy and financial markets.
detail.zh: 背离依然活跃。BTC 处于年内低点而股市处于 ATH 是经典的领先指标警告。NVDA 在创纪录业绩后下跌暗示定价已满。PMI 44.8 显示制造业深度收缩，突显了实体经济与金融市场之间的脱节。
